episode: Complete Bathroom Remodel, Sugar House Bungalow
assessment: A small bathroom in a hundred year old bungalow, and the whole story is space. A second door closed off, the vanity turned sideways, the toilet moved into a cubby cut from an old built in, and a cabinet above it reaching into the dead space behind the neighbouring TV wall. Every one of those reads in the finished footage from 9:55 onward, so the Short lives entirely in the reveal. The upstairs bathroom at 8:33 is a different room and stays out, it only confuses the story.

avoid_ranges.reason: Mike states the project cost, cost is never used
pre demo, demo, and progress. The reveal starts at 9:10
Mike's spoken outro, the Short has its own end card

project_context.summary: Main bathroom in a Sugar House bungalow, roughly a hundred years old. Two doors fought for space and the vanity was tiny. One doorway was closed off, the vanity turned sideways to a 42 inch, the toilet moved into a cubby built out of an old built in cabinet, and a linen cupboard above the toilet reaches back into the hollow space behind the entertainment centre on the other side of the wall.
project_context.segment_choice: One Short, a reveal tour, cut entirely from 9:55 to 12:15. No before footage at all: the jetted tub note from the last round applies here too, anything that was torn out is not what the Short is selling.
notes: Every frame is the finished room.
Nothing in the Short shows demo, workers, or price.

shorts.full_vo: This tiny bathroom in a hundred year old Sugar House bungalow is finally finished. There used to be a second door right here. We closed it off. That gave us the wall space to turn the vanity sideways. So a dinky little vanity became a full forty two inch one. Look underneath. The light comes on and off under the vanity. The homeowner picked the LED fixture above it. All the tile around the tub is glass tile. And that tile runs right around the whole room as a wainscot. The toilet moved into a cubby we built out of an old built in cabinet. Which got it out of the way, so the door swings in now. And that space came out of the wall behind the entertainment center in the next room. Same footprint, a hundred year old house, and every inch of it working.
shorts.voice_direction: Warm and unhurried, a contractor showing a friend around the finished room. Plain delivery, no announcer push.
